async function run(items, step) {
 const options = {reason: ""};

 await inOrder(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write", ...options});
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write", reason: ""});
 await inOrder(items, step, {...options, reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
 const serial = inOrder;
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await serial(items, step, {});
 await serial(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
 const stages = order.inOrderSteps;
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await stages([step]);
}
